description:
Sitetracker is a cloud-based project management solution designed to help enterprises manage high-volume distributed projects.

Sitetracker delivers real-time collaboration, automated reports, and forecasting for site-based project management teams. Maximize the value of your assets and shorten time to revenue by managing post-deployment activities, such as maintenance, upgrades, and marketing together in one platform. Optimize processes with automatic scheduling and assignment. Quickly share user-friendly maps to market sites to potential customers.

labeler.rationale: Describes project management with collaboration, reports, forecasting, scheduling, and assignment; these are ordinary project-planning and workflow functions and the text gives no AI signal.
evidence_spans: real-time collaboration, automated reports, and forecasting for site-based project management teams
Optimize processes with automatic scheduling and assignment.

blind.rationale: It describes project-management collaboration, automated reports, scheduling, forecasting, and asset maintenance workflows; these are conventional project-management functions, with no AI signal stated.
evidence_spans: real-time collaboration, automated reports, and forecasting for site-based project management teams

parent_concerns: Both proposals treat forecasting and automatic scheduling/assignment as ordinary project management. The text gives no forecasting or assignment mechanism. Reassess whether conventional surrounding collaboration/reports is sufficient to support the binary decision while these potentially AI-dependent functions remain unexplained. Do not infer AI merely from forecasting/automation, but do not assume a deterministic method either; preserve weak/forced uncertainty if unresolved.
